text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spot Agnes Tachyon fast asleep while
standing
perfectly upright.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Worried she might not be feeling well, I
decide to
carry her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Where am I? Ah, I see. So you
carried me
here.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, what a miscalculation on my
part.
Umamusume though I may be,
getting enough
sleep is still vital.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yet despite writing without ceasing for
rest or sleep, the quality of my thesis
didn't suffer at all.
What an important
finding.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It appears as though I have slept too
much now. I
must return to writing.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: But of course! What's wrong with that?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: But of course! What's wrong with that?
choice_data_list: You really are full of power, huh?
You're full of power, aren't you?
You're tackling a tough paper, huh.
You're tackling a tough paper, are...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Power? Yes, of course. Intellectual
stimulation far
surpasses physical limits!
choice_data_list: You really are full of power, huh?
You're full of power, aren't you?
You're tackling a tough paper, huh.
You're tackling a tough paper, are...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Intrigued, are we? Then allow me to
educate you on how one can strengthen
one's body through
knowledge. The key
is...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! I am merely collating my
research
findings. There just so happen
to be a lot of them.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, could it be you are interested in
what my thesis is about? Ah, but of
course you are! I'm
more than happy to
elaborate on it. To begin...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And that's all there is. Goodness, have I
been
talking for this long?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we continue this conversation
at my
lab? You can see what I'm talking
about for
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's fascinating, I assure you. By rapidly
 stimulating one's metabolism, it's
possible to vastly increase the amount of
muscular
hypertrophy—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh? I wasn't even done with my
explanation...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I politely decline Agnes Tachyon's
invitation by
making a swift exit from the
scene.
